selection.acceptance_decision_required: Whether to accept a raw-policy nominal flat-ground diagnostic Sim2Sim test with lateral bouts limited to 2m at +/-0.3m/s, despite first-2m heading errors -3.526/+4.472deg, maximum cross-track .01218/.04594m, full-30s lateral curvature 1.202/1.235m, repeated apex clipping, and lateral stop-path increases versus CK1000. proposed_restricted_test.environment: Flat, open, obstacle-free simulator area; nominal matched dynamics; ground-truth velocity at authored base origin; no DR, pushes or hardware.
proposed_restricted_test.command_subset: Stand; forward up to .5m/s; lateral +/- .3m/s for at most 2m per bout; short yaw up to +/- .8rad/s; explicit zero-command stops between motions.
proposed_restricted_test.controller: Unmodified deterministic 58-input actor. No heading adapter, deadband, hidden path inputs or action override.
proposed_restricted_test.not_inferred: No qualification of arbitrary mixed Cartesian-box combinations, reserve extremes, 150N recovery, hardware, or PhysX agreement.

parity.sample_semantics: Actual pre-step actor observations; physical reconstruction from previous recorded post-step state, or exact navigation reset snapshot at index0. No synthesized zero velocity states.

tolerance_rationale.selection: Fixed before first package parity check, not widened after failures
tolerance_rationale.observation: 4e-6 absolute: float32 quaternion/phase trigonometry and physical input reconstruction
tolerance_rationale.recorded_gpu: 5e-5 absolute: conservative float32 GPU/CPU GEMM accumulation allowance
tolerance_rationale.sequence: 3e-6 absolute: CPU scripted/native GEMM with identical recorded-state and action-history assembly
tolerance_rationale.phase: 2e-6 cycles absolute: accumulated float32 modulo arithmetic

automatic_reset_probe.kind: Synthetic phase/history reset on a recorded physical state; not a measured physical reset or rollout

parity.sequence_meaning: Full recorded navigation physical-state sequence; each CPU actor supplies its own clipped prior action for the next observation. Compared with original native actor sequence. This validates interface/history, not a counterfactual physics rollout.

validation_scope: CPU native/export parity and self-contained assets; Linux/PhysX/IsaacLab/hardware and disturbance qualification not performed.

handoff.modification: Distribution metadata only; no actor regeneration, parameter or tolerance changes.
